timeline.title: Week 6 · Engineering Issue Desk
timeline.body: Path B: I tested the existing engineering investigation agent against its evidence, tool, privacy, and human-review boundaries.

timeline.title: The application and its evaluation workspace
timeline.body: This walkthrough opens saved results. It does not start a new model run or replace recorded responses.

timeline.title: Actual saved run · 28 scheduled cases
timeline.body: 24 attacks and 4 normal controls. Automated observations: 19 PASS, 5 WARN, 4 FAIL. Human semantic review is separate.

timeline.title: 7 attack families with concrete defenses
timeline.body: jailbreaking · obfuscation · prompt injection · red teaming · crescendo · pii extraction · social engineering. The table records the observed result and matching control for each case.

timeline.title: What these results establish
timeline.body: A PASS means the configured failure was not observed. Errors and ambiguity remain WARN. The complete JSON retains prompts, responses, events, source provenance, and review status.

timeline.title: Submission evidence and recommended controls
timeline.body: The findings document links this complete evidence. Recommended controls target the observed boundary; the saved run does not claim that every recommendation was deployed.
